sequenceDiagram
    actor User
    participant MOD-UI as MOD-UI (ui.js)
    participant MOD-MAIN as MOD-MAIN (main.js)
    participant MOD-CATALOG as MOD-CATALOG (catalog.js)
    participant MOD-STORAGE as MOD-STORAGE (storage.js)
    participant ARCH-LOCALSTORAGE as ARCH-LOCALSTORAGE (Browser)
    User->>MOD-UI: Enters search/filter criteria
    MOD-UI->>MOD-MAIN: Trigger filter event
    MOD-MAIN->>MOD-CATALOG: executeFilter("criteria")
    MOD-CATALOG->>MOD-STORAGE: getItems()
    MOD-STORAGE->>ARCH-LOCALSTORAGE: readItem("items")
    ARCH-LOCALSTORAGE-->>MOD-STORAGE: Return JSON string
    MOD-STORAGE-->>MOD-CATALOG: Return parsed items array
    MOD-CATALOG->>MOD-CATALOG: Apply filter/sort logic
    MOD-CATALOG-->>MOD-MAIN: Return filtered list
    MOD-MAIN->>MOD-UI: renderResults("filteredItems")
    MOD-UI-->>User: Display updated gallery (<100ms)
